NOTE: Do NOT manually edit this file. This file is automatically updated when semantic release (release.yml) runs. Manually editing this file can break your releases and break third party tools that use this file.

patches.name: AMOLED theme
patches.description: Replaces the light theme with a dark AMOLED theme. Backgrounds become black and dark text becomes light. Pictures (PNG, WebP) and colors set in code are not changed.

options.title: Background color
options.description: The color of the screens that were white. Pure black turns the pixels off on AMOLED screens.

patches.name: Custom loading video
patches.description: Replaces the loading screen shown when a video starts with your own video. WebM (VP9 or AV1) or MP4 (H.265/HEVC).

options.title: Video file
options.description: The video to show. WebM with VP9 or AV1, or MP4 with H.265/HEVC. It is stored inside the app, so keep it short and small.

options.title: Scaling
options.description: How the video is sized inside the loading screen.

options.title: Loop
options.description: Repeat the video until the real video starts.

options.title: Mute
options.description: Play the loading video without sound.

options.title: Hide the original loading screen
options.description: Turn off to keep Cinevi's logo and text on top of your video.

options.title: Background color
options.description: Color behind the video when it does not cover the screen, as #RRGGBB. Leave empty to keep the original background.

options.title: Only accept WebM (VP9/AV1) and MP4 (H.265)
options.description: Turn off to embed any video file. Other formats may not play on every phone.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Removes ads (splash, banners, popups, interstitials and native ads).

patches.name: Move to Secure Folder
patches.description: Adds Samsung Secure Folder as a destination when moving items to Locked. Only active on devices where Secure Folder is available.
